s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Blend the chicken with the Parmesan, egg, half of the oregano and the salt.
Spread this mixture on a baking sheet lined with oiled parchment paper into a 30 cm disc, 5 mm thick.
Pre-bake for 15 to 18 min until the base is golden and firm; blot off any excess liquid.
Spread the tomato sauce, mozzarella, sliced mushrooms and bell pepper, olives and the remaining oregano over the crust.
Return to the oven for 10 to 12 min until the cheese is browned and bubbling.
Let rest for 3 min before cutting into slices.
l03-pizza-pate-poulet.p: Simmer the chopped tomatoes in a pan for 10 min to reduce them, so the crust doesn't turn soggy.

l03-saute-dinde-poivrons-paprika.t: Turkey and Pepper Stir-Fry with Smoked Paprika
s: Cut the turkey into 1 cm strips, then season with salt and pepper.
Sear it for 4 min over high heat in 2 tbsp of oil, then set aside.
Sauté the onion and the bell pepper strips in the remaining oil for 8 min over medium heat.
Add the garlic and paprika, stir for 1 min, then pour in the tomatoes and let them cook down for 8 min.
Return the turkey to the pan, cover and simmer for 5 min. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.
l03-saute-dinde-poivrons-paprika.p: Turkey cooks quickly: don't simmer it too long so it stays tender.

l03-roti-dinde-champignons.t: Roast Turkey with Mushrooms and Cream Sauce
s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Season the roast with salt and pepper and rub it with thyme.
In an ovenproof casserole dish, brown the roast on all sides in the butter and oil for 8 min.
Add the sliced onion, the unpeeled garlic cloves and the quartered mushrooms around the roast.
Pour in the stock, cover and bake for 50 min to 1 h (70 °C at the core), basting halfway through.
Remove the roast, wrap it in aluminium foil and let it rest for 10 min.
Place the casserole on the stove, add the cream to the juices and mushrooms and let it reduce for 5 min.
Slice the roast and spoon the mushroom sauce over it.
l03-roti-dinde-champignons.p: Leftover cold slices make excellent sandwiches wrapped in lettuce leaves.

l03-poulet-chou-cocotte.t: Chicken and Cabbage Casserole with Smoked Turkey Lardons
s: Slice the cabbage into 1 cm strips, rinse and drain.
In a casserole dish, brown the chicken thighs skin-side down for 6 min in the oil, turn and cook for 2 min, then set aside.
Sauté the turkey lardons and the sliced onion for 4 min in the rendered fat.
Add the cabbage, garlic and spices and stir for 3 min until it starts to wilt.
Pour in the stock, place the chicken on top of the cabbage, cover and simmer for 30 min over low heat.
Adjust the seasoning and serve straight from the casserole dish.
l03-poulet-chou-cocotte.p: A hearty, comforting one-pot meal for winter; it reheats perfectly.

l03-wraps-laitue-poulet-epice.t: Lettuce Wraps with Spicy Ground Chicken
s: Heat the oil in a pan over high heat, add the ground chicken and crumble it for 5 min until browned.
Add the mushrooms, garlic and ginger and cook for 3 more min.
Pour in the soy sauce and stir-fry for 1 min. Add the sliced scallions off the heat.
Mix the mayonnaise and harissa to make the sauce.
Separate nice large lettuce leaves, fill them with chicken, grated carrot and a drizzle of sauce, then roll up.
l03-wraps-laitue-poulet-epice.p: Let everyone fill their own wraps at the table: kids love it.

l03-poulet-tandoori-salade-chou.t: Tandoori-Style Chicken Drumsticks with Crunchy Cabbage Salad
s: Cut 2 or 3 deep slashes into each drumstick.
Mix the yogurt, tandoori spices, half of the lemon juice, the crushed garlic and the salt; coat the drumsticks with it and marinate for 2 h (or overnight) in the refrigerator.
Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Arrange the drumsticks on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 35 to 40 min, turning halfway through, until nicely charred.
Mix the shredded cabbage with the mayonnaise, vinegar, the remaining lemon juice, the coriander and some salt.
Serve the hot drumsticks with the cabbage salad.
l03-poulet-tandoori-salade-chou.p: Finish under the broiler for 3 min at the end of cooking for nicely caramelised drumsticks.

l03-omelette-poulet-champignons.t: Rolled Omelette with Chicken, Mushrooms and Emmental
s: Sauté the sliced mushrooms in half of the butter for 5 min, add the chicken and warm through for 2 min. Set aside.
Beat the eggs with salt, pepper and chives.
Melt the remaining butter in a large non-stick pan over medium heat and pour in the eggs.
Stir gently at first, then let set for 2 to 3 min: the top should stay slightly runny.
Spread the filling and the Emmental over one half, fold over and let the cheese melt for 1 min.
Cut in half and serve with the arugula.
l03-omelette-poulet-champignons.p: A great way to use up leftover roast chicken.

l03-poulet-citron-confit-four.t: Oven-Baked Chicken Thighs with Preserved Lemon and Olives
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the fennel into thin wedges and the preserved lemon rind into strips.
Toss the chicken thighs with the oil, crushed garlic, thyme, paprika, pepper and only a little salt (preserved lemon is salty).
Arrange the fennel in a baking dish, place the chicken on top skin-side up, and add the preserved lemon and olives.
Bake for 35 to 40 min until the skin is golden and crisp.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve with the pan juices.
l03-poulet-citron-confit-four.p: Fennel braised in the cooking juices is a great substitute for potatoes.

s: Cut the turkey and halloumi into 2.5 cm cubes, the zucchini into thick slices and the onion into chunks.
Mix the oil, lemon, mint, oregano and pepper; coat the turkey with it and marinate for 30 min.
Thread the skewers, alternating turkey, halloumi and vegetables.
Grill for 10 to 12 min on a very hot griddle or barbecue, turning often.
Serve immediately: halloumi is best piping hot.
l03-brochettes-dinde-halloumi.p: Halloumi doesn't melt when cooked: it turns golden outside and soft inside.

l03-soupe-poulet-repas.t: Hearty Chicken, Vegetable and Egg Soup
s: In a large pot, sauté the finely diced celery and carrot for 3 min in the oil.
Add the whole chicken thighs and the stock, bring to a boil and simmer for 20 min.
Remove the chicken and shred it, discarding the skin and bones.
Add the diced zucchini and the cauliflower cut into small florets to the stock and cook for 8 min.
Return the chicken to the pot, then drizzle in the beaten eggs while stirring to form ribbons.
Add the lemon juice and chopped parsley, season with salt and pepper and serve piping hot.
l03-soupe-poulet-repas.p: Keeps for 3 days in the refrigerator; if making ahead, add the eggs when reheating.

l03-poulet-sauce-poivre.t: Peppercorn Chicken Breasts with Pan-Fried Asparagus
s: Season the chicken breasts with salt and press the crushed pepper onto one side.
Cook them in the butter over medium heat for 6 to 7 min on each side. Keep warm.
Deglaze with the stock, add the cream and reduce for 4 min until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Meanwhile, trim the tough ends of the asparagus and pan-fry for 6 to 8 min in the oil with the crushed garlic and some salt.
Spoon the pepper sauce over the chicken breasts and serve with the asparagus.
l03-poulet-sauce-poivre.p: Replace the asparagus with green beans depending on the season.

l03-poulet-effiloche-coleslaw.t: Keto BBQ Pulled Chicken and Coleslaw
i: smoked paprika, garlic powder and onion powder
s: Rub the chicken with the spices and salt, then brown it for 5 min in the oil in a casserole dish.
Mix the tomato paste, half of the vinegar, erythritol, mustard and stock; pour over the chicken.
Cover and simmer for 35 to 40 min over low heat until the meat falls apart.
Shred the chicken with a fork in the casserole dish and let the sauce reduce for 5 min, uncovered.
For the coleslaw, finely slice the cabbages and mix them with the mayonnaise, the remaining vinegar and some salt.
Serve the pulled chicken over the coleslaw or in lettuce leaves.
l03-poulet-effiloche-coleslaw.p: Freezes very well in portions; perfect for weekday lunches.

s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and butter a 26 cm tart pan.
Finely slice the leek and sweat it for 8 min in the butter over low heat.
Beat the eggs with the cream, nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Spread the chicken, leeks and half of the Emmental in the pan; pour in the egg mixture.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and bake for 30 to 35 min until the quiche is set and golden.
Let cool for 10 min before slicing.
l03-quiche-sans-pate-poulet-poireaux.p: Delicious warm or cold; ideal in a lunchbox with a green salad.

l03-dinde-curry-coco-courgettes.t: Red Curry Turkey Stir-Fry with Zucchini
s: Slice the turkey into thin strips, the zucchini into half-moons and the bell pepper into strips.
Sear the turkey for 3 to 4 min in very hot coconut oil, then set aside.
Sauté the garlic, ginger and spices for 1 min, then add the vegetables and cook for 4 min.
Pour in the coconut milk and soy sauce and simmer for 6 min.
Return the turkey for 3 min to warm it through without drying it out, then add the lime juice and basil.
l03-dinde-curry-coco-courgettes.p: Add fresh chili for the adults at serving time.

l03-salade-foies-volaille-tiede.t: Warm Chicken Liver Salad with Walnuts and Cider Vinegar
s: Trim the livers, cut them in half and pat them very dry.
Make the vinaigrette: 2 tbsp of oil, half of the vinegar, the mustard, salt and pepper.
Arrange the salad greens, the cut tomatoes, the sliced red onion and the walnuts on two plates.
Sear the livers in the remaining very hot oil for 2 min per side.
Deglaze with the remaining vinegar, season with salt and pepper, and immediately pour the livers and their juices over the dressed salad.
l03-salade-foies-volaille-tiede.p: Serve immediately to enjoy the hot-and-cold contrast.

l03-poulet-crapaudine-harissa-citron.t: Grilled Spatchcock Chicken with Harissa-Lemon Butter
s: Place the chicken breast-side down and cut along both sides of the backbone with poultry shears; remove it.
Turn the chicken over and press firmly on the breastbone to flatten it. Preheat the oven to 210 °C.
Mix the butter, harissa, zest, crushed garlic and salt; slip half under the skin and spread the rest on top.
Lay the chicken flat, skin-side up, on an oiled baking sheet and drizzle with lemon juice.
Roast for 45 to 50 min until the skin is golden and the juices from the thigh run clear.
Let rest for 10 min, carve, and serve over the arugula drizzled with the pan juices.
l03-poulet-crapaudine-harissa-citron.p: Flattened, the chicken cooks 30% faster and more evenly than whole.

s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Mix the chicken, well-drained broccoli, cheddar, eggs, almond flour, garlic, salt and pepper.
Using a tablespoon, shape 16 walnut-sized croquettes and flatten them slightly.
Brush with oil and bake for 18 to 20 min, turning halfway through.
Mix the yogurt, chives and salt for the sauce and serve with the hot croquettes.
l03-croquettes-poulet-fromage.p: Perfect for using up leftover chicken; the croquettes reheat well in a pan.

s: Cut the chicken into large pieces and put them in a casserole dish with the stock, the halved onion and the sliced carrot.
Bring to a simmer, skim off the foam and cook, covered, for 30 min over low heat.
Meanwhile, sauté the quartered mushrooms in the butter for 6 min.
Remove the chicken and vegetables and reduce the stock by half over high heat (about 10 min).
Whisk the crème fraîche with the egg yolks and lemon juice, pour a ladle of hot stock over it, then return everything to the casserole over very low heat, without boiling, stirring until thickened.
Add the chicken and mushrooms back, warm through for 2 min, adjust the seasoning and sprinkle with parsley.
l03-blanquette-poulet-keto.p: Thickening with egg yolks replaces flour: never let the sauce boil.

l03-salade-poulet-avocat-feta.t: Grilled Chicken Salad with Avocado, Feta and Seeds
s: Rub the chicken breasts with paprika, salt, pepper and a drizzle of oil.
Grill for 5 to 6 min per side in a hot grill pan, let rest, then slice.
Dice the avocado and cucumber and crumble the feta.
Toss the arugula with the remaining oil and the lemon, then add the vegetables, feta and warm chicken.
Sprinkle with pumpkin seeds toasted for 2 min in a dry pan.
l03-salade-poulet-avocat-feta.p: Prepare the chicken breasts the day before for a quick lunchbox.

l03-poulet-thai-basilic.t: Thai Basil Chicken Stir-Fry with Fried Egg
i: boneless chicken thighs, chopped by hand with a knife
s: Coarsely chop the chicken with a knife; crush the garlic and chili.
Fry the eggs in 1 tbsp of very hot oil to get crispy edges; set aside.
In a wok, stir-fry the garlic and chili for 30 sec in the remaining oil, then the chicken for 5 min over high heat.
Add the green beans and 2 tbsp of water and stir-fry for 3 min.
Pour in the soy sauce and erythritol, mix, then add the basil off the heat.
Serve each portion topped with a fried egg.
l03-poulet-thai-basilic.p: Serve with cauliflower rice for a complete meal.

l03-gratin-dinde-aubergines.t: Ground Turkey and Eggplant Gratin with Mozzarella
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the eggplants into 1 cm slices, brush them with 3 tbsp of oil, season with salt and roast for 20 min on a baking sheet.
Meanwhile, sauté the chopped onion in the remaining oil, then the turkey for 6 min, crumbling it.
Add the garlic, spices and tomatoes and simmer for 10 min.
In a baking dish, alternate layers of eggplant and turkey sauce, finishing with eggplant.
Cover with mozzarella and Parmesan and bake for 20 min until the gratin is golden.
Let rest for 10 min before serving, sprinkled with parsley.
l03-gratin-dinde-aubergines.p: Roasting the eggplants instead of frying them keeps them from absorbing too much oil.

l03-poulet-cajun-avocat.t: Cajun Chicken Breasts with Avocado Salsa
s: Slice the chicken breasts in half horizontally to make thin cutlets.
Mix the Cajun spices with the salt and 2 tbsp of oil and coat the chicken with it.
Cook for 4 to 5 min per side in a hot pan with the remaining oil.
Dice the avocados, tomato and red onion; mix with the lime, coriander and salt.
Serve the sliced chicken with the salsa.
l03-poulet-cajun-avocat.p: Mix a big jar of Cajun spices: it keeps for 6 months.

l03-cuisses-laquees-moutarde-sesame.t: Mustard and Sesame Glazed Chicken Legs with Brussels Sprouts
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Mix the mustard, soy sauce, erythritol and crushed garlic.
Brush the chicken legs with half of this mixture and place them in a large baking dish.
Halve the Brussels sprouts, toss them with the oil, salt and pepper and spread them around the chicken.
Bake for 25 min, brush the chicken with the remaining glaze and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Continue for 15 min until the chicken is glazed and the sprouts are nicely browned.
l03-cuisses-laquees-moutarde-sesame.p: Roasting takes the bitterness out of Brussels sprouts: a good way to get kids to like them.

l03-poulet-epinards-parmesan-creme.t: Creamy Tuscan Chicken with Spinach and Tomatoes
s: Season the chicken breasts with oregano, paprika, salt and pepper.
Brown them in the oil for 6 min per side over medium heat, then set aside.
Sauté the garlic and the halved cherry tomatoes for 3 min in the same pan.
Pour in the cream and Parmesan and stir until the sauce is smooth.
Add the spinach and let it wilt for 1 min, then return the chicken to the sauce for 3 min.
l03-poulet-epinards-parmesan-creme.p: Serve over zucchini noodles or konjac noodles.

l03-terrine-foies-volaille.t: Chicken Liver Butter Mousse with Crunchy Salad
s: Trim the livers and pat them dry. Melt 30 g of butter and sweat the onion and garlic for 3 min.
Add the livers and thyme and cook for 6 to 8 min over medium heat, until no longer pink in the middle (70 °C at the core).
Blend the warm livers with the remaining butter in pieces, the cream, spices, salt and pepper until you get a very smooth mousse.
Pour into ramekins or a small terrine, smooth the top, cover and refrigerate for at least 4 h.
Serve the mousse with cucumber sticks, radishes and green salad leaves for spreading.
l03-terrine-foies-volaille.p: Covered with a thin layer of melted butter, the mousse keeps for 5 days in the refrigerator.

l03-paupiettes-dinde-jben-epinards.t: Turkey Roulades with Fresh Cheese and Spinach
s: Wilt the spinach for 2 min in a pan with the garlic, squeeze it dry and chop; mix with the jben, salt and pepper.
Flatten the cutlets between two sheets of plastic wrap, lay a slice of smoked turkey on each, then a layer of filling.
Roll them up tightly and tie with kitchen string or secure with toothpicks.
Brown the roulades in the butter for 5 min on all sides.
Pour in the stock, cover and simmer for 20 min over low heat, turning halfway through.
Remove the roulades, add the cream to the juices and reduce for 3 min. Spoon over the roulades and serve.
l03-paupiettes-dinde-jben-epinards.p: Prepare the roulades the day before; they hold together better after a night in the refrigerator.

l03-brochettes-sumac-fattouche.t: Sumac Chicken Thigh Skewers with Keto Fattoush Salad
s: Cut the chicken into cubes and marinate for 1 h with 2 tbsp of oil, half of the lemon, the garlic, half of the spices and the salt.
Thread the pieces onto skewers and grill for 12 to 15 min on a hot grill, turning.
Dice the cucumber, tomato and radishes, chop the mint and parsley and slice the lettuce.
Dress the salad with the remaining oil, lemon, sumac and some salt.
Serve the skewers over the salad, dusted with a pinch of sumac.
l03-brochettes-sumac-fattouche.p: For fattoush-style crunch, add pumpkin seeds toasted in a dry pan instead of bread croutons.

l03-poulet-chou-fleur-curry-four.t: Roasted Turmeric Chicken and Cauliflower with Tahini Sauce
s: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut the chicken into large cubes and the cauliflower into florets.
Toss them with the oil, spices and salt and spread on a large baking sheet.
Bake for 30 to 35 min, stirring halfway through, until the cauliflower is well browned.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, crushed garlic, water and a pinch of salt until you get a pourable sauce.
Serve drizzled with tahini sauce and sprinkled with parsley.
l03-poulet-chou-fleur-curry-four.p: Everything cooks on a single sheet: ideal for weekly meal prep.

l04-steak-sauce-poivre.t: Pepper Steak with Cream, Green Beans
s: Take the steaks out of the refrigerator 20 minutes before cooking. Season with salt and press the crushed pepper onto both sides.
Cook the green beans for 8 minutes in salted boiling water, drain and keep warm.
Heat the oil and half of the butter in a pan over high heat. Sear the steaks for 2 to 3 minutes per side for medium, then set aside on a plate under a sheet of aluminium foil.
Lower the heat, pour the cream and mustard into the pan, scraping up the browned bits. Reduce for 2 to 3 minutes until the sauce coats the back of a spoon.
Add the remaining butter and the juices released by the meat, stir, and adjust the salt.
Serve the steaks topped with the sauce, with the green beans tossed in the remaining sauce for 1 minute.
l04-steak-sauce-poivre.p: For a milder sauce, replace half of the black pepper with crushed green peppercorns in brine.

s: Slice the onion, chop the garlic and dice the bell pepper.
Heat the oil in a casserole dish and sauté the onion and bell pepper for 5 minutes over medium heat.
Add the ground beef, turn up the heat and brown it for 6 to 8 minutes, crumbling it with a wooden spoon.
Stir in the garlic, tomato paste, spices and chili; stir for 1 minute to toast the spices.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes and 100 ml of water, then season with salt. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes over low heat, stirring occasionally.
Serve in bowls with a spoonful of crème fraîche, the shredded cheddar and chopped coriander.
l04-chili-sans-haricots.p: Even better the next day: keeps for 3 days in the refrigerator and 3 months in the freezer.

s: Mix the beef, egg, Parmesan, almond flour, 1 grated garlic clove, chopped parsley, salt and pepper.
With damp hands, shape about 20 walnut-sized meatballs.
Brown them for 6 minutes in a pan with 1 tbsp of oil over medium-high heat, rolling them to colour all sides.
In a deep skillet, sauté the other chopped garlic clove in the remaining oil, add the tomatoes and salt, and reduce for 10 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Place the meatballs in a baking dish, cover with the sauce and top with torn mozzarella.
Bake for 12 minutes until the cheese is bubbling, then sprinkle with basil.
l04-boulettes-sauce-tomate-mozzarella.p: Double the quantity of meatballs and freeze them raw on a baking sheet before transferring to a freezer bag.

l04-boeuf-bourguignon-sans-vin.t: Slow-Cooked Beef Bourguignon-Style with Mushrooms (No Wine)
s: Pat the meat dry with paper towels, then season with salt and pepper.
In a casserole dish, brown the meat in 3 batches in very hot oil, 4 minutes per batch, and set aside.
Lower the heat, sauté the sliced onion and carrot rounds for 5 minutes, then the garlic and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Deglaze with the vinegar, return the meat, add the stock and the thyme and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer for 2 h 15 over very low heat (or in the oven at 150 °C) until the meat falls apart with a fork.
Meanwhile, sauté the quartered mushrooms in the butter for 8 minutes over high heat.
Add the mushrooms 15 minutes before the end, uncover to reduce the sauce if needed, and sprinkle with parsley.
l04-boeuf-bourguignon-sans-vin.p: Serve with cauliflower mash. The dish reheats very well and freezes in portions.

l04-moussaka-keto.t: Keto Lamb Moussaka with Cheese Béchamel
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the eggplants into 1 cm slices, brush them with oil, season with salt and roast for 20 minutes on a baking sheet.
Sauté the chopped onion in 1 tbsp of oil, add the lamb and brown for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, spices and tomatoes, season with salt and simmer for 15 minutes uncovered until the sauce is thick. Stir in the parsley.
For the keto béchamel, heat the cream with the cream cheese while whisking, remove from the heat and stir in the beaten eggs and half of the Parmesan.
In a baking dish, alternate eggplant and meat, finishing with eggplant, then pour over the béchamel and sprinkle with the remaining Parmesan.
Lower the oven to 180 °C and bake for 30 minutes until the top is golden.
Let cool for 15 minutes before serving.
l04-moussaka-keto.p: Can be made the day before: assemble, cover and refrigerate, then add 10 minutes to the cooking time.

s: Cut the cauliflower into florets and steam for 12 minutes until very tender.
Drain thoroughly, then blend with the butter, crème fraîche, nutmeg, salt and pepper into a smooth mash.
In an oiled pan, sauté the chopped onion for 4 minutes, add the beef and brown for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, tomato paste and stock, reduce for 5 minutes, then stir in the parsley.
Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Spread the meat in a baking dish, cover with the mash and sprinkle with Emmental.
Bake for 20 minutes, then place under the broiler for 3 minutes for a golden crust.
l04-hachis-parmentier-chou-fleur.p: Let the cauliflower drain in a colander for 5 minutes before blending: the mash will be firmer.

s: Cut the lamb into 3 cm cubes. Mix with the lemon juice, oil, 1 grated garlic clove, the spices, salt and pepper; marinate for 1 hour in the refrigerator (or overnight).
Grate the cucumber, squeeze it in a cloth to remove the water, then mix it into the yogurt with the other garlic clove and the chopped mint. Season with salt.
Cut the bell pepper and onion into 3 cm squares.
Thread onto skewers, alternating meat and vegetables.
Grill for 10 to 12 minutes on a very hot grill or grill pan, turning every 3 minutes.
Let rest for 3 minutes and serve with the well-chilled tzatziki.
l04-brochettes-agneau-tzatziki.p: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes so they don't burn.

l04-cotelettes-agneau-herbes-puree-celer.t: Herb-Crusted Lamb Chops with Celeriac Mash
s: Rub the chops with 1 tbsp of oil, the crushed garlic, the thyme and rosemary, salt and pepper; let rest for 15 minutes.
Peel the celeriac, cut it into cubes and cook for 20 minutes in salted water until tender.
Drain and blend the celeriac with the butter and warm cream, then season with salt and pepper.
Heat the remaining oil in a large pan over high heat. Sear the chops for 2 to 3 minutes per side, browning the fat edge too.
Let rest for 3 minutes, drizzle with a little lemon juice and sprinkle with parsley.
Serve 3 chops per person over the celeriac mash.
l04-cotelettes-agneau-herbes-puree-celer.p: Celeriac mash is rich in carbs: keep the portion to about 100 g per person.

s: Take the roast out 1 hour before cooking. Preheat the oven to 220 °C.
Brush it with the mustard mixed with 1 tbsp of oil, the thyme, salt and pepper.
Sear it on all sides for 5 minutes in a very hot pan, then place it in a dish with the unpeeled garlic cloves and the butter.
Cut the vegetables into pieces, toss with the remaining oil and some salt, and arrange around the roast.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes for medium-rare (55 °C at the core), basting halfway through.
Let the roast rest for 10 minutes under foil before slicing thinly. Serve with the vegetables and the pan juices.
l04-roti-boeuf-legumes.p: Leftovers, thinly sliced and cold, make excellent salads the next day.

l04-escalope-veau-champignons.t: Veal Cutlets in Creamy Mushroom Sauce
s: Flatten the cutlets between two sheets of parchment paper, then season with salt and pepper.
Heat the oil and half of the butter over high heat and cook the cutlets for 2 minutes per side. Keep warm.
In the same pan, sauté the chopped onion and sliced mushrooms with the remaining butter for 6 minutes.
Pour in the cream and mustard, reduce for 3 minutes, then return the cutlets for 1 minute to warm through.
Wilt the spinach for 2 minutes in another pan with a pinch of salt.
Serve the cutlets topped with the sauce and sprinkled with parsley, alongside the spinach.
l04-escalope-veau-champignons.p: Veal cooks very quickly: beyond 2 minutes per side, it dries out.

l04-steak-hache-oeuf-cheval-salade.t: Hamburger Steak with Fried Egg and Avocado Salad
s: Season the patties with salt and pepper.
Heat a pan with 1 tsp of oil over high heat and cook the patties for 4 to 5 minutes per side, until well done all the way through (70 °C at the core, no pink left). Set aside.
In the same pan over medium heat, fry the eggs for 3 minutes until the white is set (fully cooked yolk for children, pregnant women and vulnerable people).
Dice the avocado and halve the tomatoes; toss with the arugula, the remaining oil, the lemon juice and some salt.
Top each patty with an egg and serve with the salad.
l04-steak-hache-oeuf-cheval-salade.p: Spoon some hot fat from the pan over the egg whites so they cook through without flipping.

l04-bowl-burger-deconstruit.t: Deconstructed Burger Bowl with Special Sauce
s: Brown the ground beef for 8 minutes in a hot pan with the paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper, crumbling it.
Make the sauce: mix the mayonnaise, tomato paste, mustard, vinegar and 2 finely chopped pickles.
Slice the romaine, halve the tomatoes, thinly slice the onion and cut the remaining pickles into rounds.
Divide the lettuce among 4 bowls, then add the hot meat, cheddar, tomatoes, onion and pickles.
Drizzle with the sauce and sprinkle with sesame seeds toasted for 1 minute in a dry pan.
l04-bowl-burger-deconstruit.p: For the office, keep the meat and sauce in separate containers and reheat only the meat.

s: Cut the zucchini into 5 mm slices and sauté for 8 minutes over high heat in half of the oil to drive off their water. Season with salt.
In another pan, sauté the chopped onion in the remaining oil, add the beef, garlic and herbs; cook for 8 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Beat the eggs with the crème fraîche, half of the Emmental, salt and pepper.
In a gratin dish, layer half of the zucchini, the meat, then the remaining zucchini.
Pour over the egg-cream mixture, sprinkle with the remaining Emmental and bake for 25 minutes until set and golden.
l04-gratin-courgettes-viande-hachee.p: Add a handful of chopped fresh mint to the meat for a fresher note.

l04-agneau-roti-romarin-haricots.t: Garlic Roast Leg of Lamb with Green Beans
i: bone-in leg of lamb, 1.6 kg (~1.3 kg of meat)
s: Take the lamb out 1 hour before cooking. Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Make small incisions in the meat and slip in 3 garlic cloves cut into slivers.
Rub the lamb with the oil, rosemary and thyme, lemon zest, salt and pepper. Place it in a dish with the remaining unpeeled garlic and the water.
Roast for 1 h 20 to 1 h 30, basting with the juices every 20 minutes; add a little water if the bottom starts to burn.
Let rest for 15 minutes under foil. Meanwhile, cook the green beans for 8 minutes in salted water and pan-fry them in the butter.
Carve the lamb, drizzle with the cooking juices and lemon juice, and serve with the green beans.
l04-agneau-roti-romarin-haricots.p: Shredded leftovers reheat in a pan with a little juice for a quick lunch.

l04-boeuf-saute-brocoli-gingembre.t: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry with Ginger
s: Place the meat in the freezer for 20 minutes to make it easier to slice thinly against the grain.
Mix the soy sauce, erythritol, ginger, chopped garlic and 2 tbsp of water.
Cut the broccoli into small florets and blanch them for 2 minutes in boiling water, then drain.
Heat half of the oil in a wok over very high heat, sear the meat in 2 batches for 1 minute each, then set aside.
Add the remaining oil, stir-fry the broccoli for 2 minutes, return the meat and pour in the sauce; toss for 1 minute.
Serve sprinkled with sesame seeds, sliced scallions and a pinch of chili.
l04-boeuf-saute-brocoli-gingembre.p: Serve over cauliflower rice or konjac noodles for a more filling dish.

s: Put the meat in a casserole dish, cover with cold water, bring to a boil for 2 minutes, then drain and rinse (this prevents scum).
Return the meat to the pot with the stock, the carrot, onion and leek cut into pieces, and the thyme and bay leaf. Simmer, covered, for 1 h 15 over low heat.
Sauté the quartered mushrooms in the butter for 6 minutes.
Remove the meat and vegetables with a slotted spoon. Reduce the stock over high heat to about 400 ml.
Off the heat, whisk the cream with the egg yolks and lemon juice, pour a ladle of hot stock over it, then pour everything back into the casserole dish.
Return to very low heat without boiling for 3 minutes until thickened, add the meat, carrots and mushrooms, adjust the seasoning and sprinkle with parsley.
l04-blanquette-veau-champignons.p: Once the yolks are added, the sauce must not boil again, or it will curdle.

s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line a loaf pan with parchment paper.
Mix the beef, eggs, almond flour, finely chopped onion and garlic, parsley, paprika, mustard, salt and pepper.
Spread half of the meat in the pan, sprinkle with cheddar, then cover with the remaining meat, pressing down.
Mix the tomato paste, vinegar, erythritol and 2 tbsp of water; brush over the top of the meatloaf.
Bake for 50 minutes, until it reaches 70 °C at the core.
Let rest for 10 minutes before unmolding and slicing.
l04-pain-viande-cheddar.p: Sliced cold, it replaces deli meat in lunchboxes.

l04-brochettes-kefta-salade-concombre.t: Grilled Kefta Skewers with Cucumber-Feta Salad
s: Mix the meat with the grated, squeezed onion, the chopped herbs, the spices, salt and pepper. Let rest for 15 minutes in the refrigerator.
Mould into elongated sausage shapes around 8 flat skewers, pressing firmly.
Dice the cucumber, tomato and feta, then add the olives, oil, lemon and pepper.
Grill the skewers for 8 to 10 minutes on a very hot grill or under the oven broiler, turning 3 times.
Serve the skewers over the salad.
l04-brochettes-kefta-salade-concombre.p: Wet your hands when shaping the meat: it will stick better to the skewer.

s: Preheat the oven to 190 °C. Grate the cauliflower into rice-sized pieces and microwave for 3 minutes.
Sauté the chopped onion and beef for 8 minutes. Add the tomato paste, mustard, salt and pepper.
Mix the meat, cauliflower rice and chopped pickles, then spread in a buttered baking dish.
Beat the eggs with the cream and half of the cheddar; pour over the meat.
Sprinkle with the remaining cheddar and the sesame seeds and bake for 25 minutes.
Serve with a green salad and a few pickle slices.
l04-cheeseburger-casserole.p: All the flavour of a cheeseburger without the bun: ideal for kids who ask for burgers.

l04-paleron-braise-legumes-racines.t: Braised Beef Chuck with Root Vegetables
s: Preheat the oven to 150 °C. Season the meat with salt and brown it in the oil in a cast-iron casserole dish, 3 minutes per side, in 2 batches.
Add the sliced onion and the celery cut into chunks; sauté for 5 minutes, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes, stock and herbs; bring to a simmer.
Cover and bake for 2 h 30.
Add the peeled turnips cut into wedges and continue baking for 30 minutes.
Remove the meat, shred it lightly, spoon the sauce over it and sprinkle with parsley.
l04-paleron-braise-legumes-racines.p: Cooked in the oven, the beef doesn't stick and stays tender; you can also use a slow cooker for 8 hours on low.

s: Brush the meat with oil, then sear for 3 minutes per side in a very hot pan. Let rest for 5 minutes.
Mix the lime juice, soy sauce and sliced chili.
Cut the cucumber into half-moons, the onion into thin slices, and pick the herb leaves.
Slice the meat into thin strips and toss it, still warm, with the sauce.
Arrange the lettuce, vegetables and herbs, add the meat and sprinkle with crushed peanuts.
l04-salade-tiede-boeuf-thai.p: Rare to medium-rare gives the best texture; overcooked, it turns rubbery.

l04-merguez-gratin-aubergine.t: Eggplant and Merguez Gratin with Mozzarella
s: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Cut the eggplants into cubes, toss with the oil and some salt, and roast for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, brown the merguez for 6 minutes in a pan, then slice into rounds.
In the degreased pan, sauté the chopped garlic for 30 seconds, add the tomatoes and reduce for 5 minutes.
Combine the eggplants, merguez and sauce in a gratin dish.
Top with sliced mozzarella and Parmesan and bake for 15 minutes.
Sprinkle with basil just before serving.
l04-merguez-gratin-aubergine.p: Merguez already brings salt and spices: go easy on the salt in the sauce.

s: Keep the meat in the refrigerator until the last moment. Cut it by hand into small 3 mm dice (don't use a grinder).
Finely chop the pickles, onion and parsley.
Mix the meat with the mustard, oil, chopped condiments, salt and pepper.
Dice the avocado and sprinkle it with lemon juice.
Plate using a ring mould: a layer of avocado, then the tartare. Make a small well and set the egg yolk in it.
Serve immediately with the arugula.
l04-tartare-boeuf-avocat.p: Buy the meat the same day from the butcher and tell them it's for tartare. Not recommended for pregnant women and young children (raw meat and raw egg).

s: Season the cutlets with salt and pepper and dredge them in the almond flour.
Heat the oil and half of the butter; brown the cutlets for 1 min 30 per side. Keep warm.
Deglaze the pan with the stock and the juice of 1 lemon, reduce for 2 minutes, then finish the sauce with the remaining butter.
Cut the zucchini into ribbons with a vegetable peeler and sauté for 2 minutes over high heat with a pinch of salt.
Return the cutlets to the sauce for 30 seconds, add the parsley and slices from the remaining half lemon.
Serve over the zucchini ribbons sprinkled with Parmesan.
l04-veau-piccata-citron.p: Ask the butcher for very thin cutlets for lightning-fast cooking.

l04-entrecote-beurre-persille.t: Grilled Ribeye with Parsley Butter and Asparagus
s: Mash the softened butter with the chopped parsley, grated garlic, lemon and a pinch of salt. Roll into a log in plastic wrap and freeze for 15 minutes.
Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus. Roast for 8 minutes in a pan with half of the oil and some salt, rolling them.
Pat the ribeye dry and season with salt. Sear it in a smoking-hot cast-iron pan with the remaining oil, 3 minutes per side for rare to medium.
Also sear the fat edge for 1 minute, holding the meat with tongs.
Let rest for 5 minutes, slice, season with pepper and top with slices of parsley butter.
Serve with the asparagus.
l04-entrecote-beurre-persille.p: Parsley butter keeps for 3 months in the freezer: cut off slices as needed.

l04-boulettes-agneau-feta-menthe.t: Feta-Mint Lamb Meatballs with Yogurt Sauce
s: Mix the ground lamb with the feta, half of the chopped mint, the grated onion, the spices, the almond flour and pepper (little salt, as feta is salty).
Shape 16 meatballs and chill for 10 minutes so they hold together.
Make the sauce: yogurt, grated garlic, lemon juice, the remaining mint and a pinch of salt.
Brown the meatballs in the oil over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning regularly.
Serve over a bed of arugula with the yogurt sauce.
l04-boulettes-agneau-feta-menthe.p: These meatballs can also be baked: 15 minutes at 200 °C on a baking sheet.

l04-emince-veau-creme-poivrons.t: Veal Strips in Creamy Red Pepper Sauce
s: Grate the cauliflower into rice-sized grains and sauté for 5 minutes in a pan with 1 tsp of oil and some salt. Set aside.
Sear the veal strips in 1 tbsp of very hot oil for 3 minutes. Set aside.
Sauté the sliced onion and the bell pepper strips for 8 minutes over medium heat with the remaining oil.
Add the garlic and paprika for 30 seconds, then the cream; let thicken for 3 minutes.
Return the veal and its juices to the sauce for 1 minute, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve over the cauliflower rice, sprinkled with parsley.
l04-emince-veau-creme-poivrons.p: Add a pinch of hot chili to the paprika for a goulash-style version.

s: Brown the meat in 3 batches in very hot oil, season with salt and set aside.
In the casserole dish, soften the sliced onion for 8 minutes over low heat until golden.
Off the heat, add the paprika and garlic and stir for 30 seconds (paprika burns easily).
Return to the heat with the tomato paste, tomatoes, diced bell pepper, meat and stock.
Cover and simmer for 1 h 45 over low heat until the meat is tender.
Add the vinegar, adjust the seasoning and sprinkle with parsley.
l04-goulash-boeuf-paprika.p: Serve with a spoonful of sour cream (crème fraîche + lemon) unless you're aiming for a dairy-free dish.

s: Mix the ground lamb with the grated garlic, spices, salt and pepper; shape into 4 patties slightly wider than the mushrooms.
Remove the mushroom stems, brush the caps with oil, season with salt and grill for 4 minutes per side. They serve as the buns.
Cook the patties for 4 minutes per side in a hot pan.
Place a slice of goat cheese on each patty during the last minute, with the lid on.
Assemble: mushroom cap, mayonnaise, arugula, goat-cheese patty, red onion, then a second cap.
Secure with a skewer and serve immediately.
l04-burger-agneau-champignon-portobello.p: Blot the grilled mushrooms well on paper towels to avoid a soggy burger.

s: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Season the roast with salt and pepper and brown it on all sides for 8 minutes in a casserole dish with the oil and butter.
Brush it with mustard, add the sliced onion and thyme around it, and pour in the stock.
Cover and bake for 50 minutes, basting twice.
Add the quartered mushrooms, uncover and continue for 15 minutes.
Remove the roast and let it rest under foil. Place the casserole on the stove, pour in the cream and reduce for 3 minutes.
Slice the roast and serve topped with the mushroom sauce.
l04-roti-veau-moutarde.p: Veal is lean: don't go above 65 °C at the core to keep the meat pink and juicy.
